parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The question. It must not be empty. The server refuses the value "*".

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace. If you do not send it, the server uses the workspace of the session.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Only facts about this repository path, team or project. A path also includes the facts about its parent paths and its child paths. The response always includes entries with no scope.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of hits. The default is 20. The server ignores a value that is not a positive integer.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Only these kinds of entry. Send a list with commas, or send the parameter more than one time. With this filter, the response holds no page bodies.

parameters.name: moduleIds
parameters.description: Put knowledge about these modules, and about their neighbour modules, at the top. This parameter changes the order only. It does not remove hits. Send a list with commas.

parameters.name: issueId
parameters.description: Put knowledge about the modules and the capability of this issue at the top.

parameters.name: x-vantik-session
parameters.description: The session of the agent harness. The server records it with each entry that it serves. The server ignores a value longer than 200 characters.
